document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You warn Sylvia and Norman to get ready. Your party takes 
position behind a bush heavy with orchid-like blossoms and 
waits for the yelping beasts.

Moments  later,  they  burst  into  view—incredible  canines 
which  resemble  reconstructed  museum  specimens  of  dire 
wolves. You hear a sudden intake of breath from both students. 
Have you put them in mortal danger? It’s too late to run.
